text: How many apples do you want?
Good morning. Yes, please. How much is one baguette?
One euro twenty. The big one is two euros fifty.
One baguette, please. And do you have any cheese?
Of course. How many pieces do you want?
Two small pieces. How much is that?
Twelve euros for the two. It is not cheap, but it is very good cheese.
That's fine. And how many apples for five euros?
One kilo, about eight apples. They are from the south, and this week they are very cheap.
Perfect. My daughter always eats two apples in the morning. How much is everything?
Eighteen euros twenty. You can pay here with a credit card.

Good morning, and welcome to the Bastille market. Here is some information for today. We are open from seven in the morning to half past two. How much is the bread? One baguette is one euro twenty, and a big loaf is two euros fifty. The cheese is at the third table on the left. How many pieces do you want? One small piece is about six euros. We have some apples from the south of France today, and they are very cheap: five euros for one kilo. We don't have any strawberries this week, sorry. You can pay with a credit card at every table. Thank you, and have a very good Saturday.

Hello, this is a message from the cheese shop on Rue Paul Bert. You asked about our prices, so here they are. A small piece of cheese is six euros. A big piece is eleven euros. If you want some cheese for a family of three, one big piece is enough. We also have some bread, but not much, and only in the morning. How many people are coming to your dinner? Call us and we can prepare a box for you. One more thing: on Sunday we are closed, so please come on Saturday. We open at eight and we close at one. Thank you very much.
Good morning. How much is the bread? One euro twenty for one baguette. How many apples do you want? Three, please. And some cheese. That is nine euros.
How many apples do you want?
How many tickets do you need for the museum?
We don't have any cheese today.
